title: fix(fields): the people picker's list scrolls by wheel and touch inside a dialog
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_
Fixes #36852

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziG2t1d9cfRQJDrHkB

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在弹窗表单里点人员字段，弹出的人员列表现在能用滚轮和手指滚动，排在下面的人也能选到；人员选择器在电脑上的居中对话框里同样能滚动了，手机上的底部面板不变。
- 为什么做：查找选择器的同类问题修好后，复核发现人员选择器在弹窗里也滚不动，候选人一多就选不到后面的人。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是下拉打开时点页面别处要先点一下关掉下拉，或屏幕阅读器暂时读不到下拉后面的页面，与查找选择器已接受的表现相同；可整体撤回这一个提交。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

Confirmed cause, reproduced on main before any change (Chromium, 1280x800 with touch enabled, the inline PeoplePicker in a Radix `Dialog`, 60 users, 25 loaded; readings below). It has **two** parts, and the second is one the card did not name:

1. **The dialog's scroll lock cancelled every move over the popover.** Radix Dialog mounts `react-remove-scroll` with the dialog content as its only shard; the inline popover portals to the body, outside it, so every `wheel` and `touchmove` over the popover is `preventDefault`ed (5 of 5 wheel, 9 of 9 touchmove). Outside a dialog none is.
2. **The list had nothing to scroll, dialog or not.** The popover is capped by `max-h-[min(28rem,60vh)]` only, so it has no definite height; the list area (`ScrollArea`, `min-h-0 flex-1`) is clipped to the room left, but its Radix viewport is `h-full`, which against an indefinite height falls back to its content height. Measured: viewport 1248px tall, `scrollHeight - clientHeight` = 0, so the rows past the popover's edge were clipped, not scrollable, even outside a dialog. With only `modal` added the list still does not move.

The fix, in `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/PeoplePicker.tsx` only:

- the inline desktop popover is `modal`, its own scroll-lock layer, the treatment #36844 gave LookupField (consumption of an existing Radix prop; no change in `@object-ui/components`);
- the list area is `flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col`, so the viewport is a flex item that shrinks to the room the area is given and scrolls. This is the "another one" the card allows, named here.

The list area is shared by the picker's three containers. The phone's bottom sheet (`h-[85vh]`, a definite height) measures the same before and after. The centred desktop dialog (`max-h-[80vh]`) had the same clipped, unscrollable list and now scrolls.

What `modal` brings with it, already accepted for the lookup popover: while the popover is open the page behind it is `aria-hidden`, focus stays in the popover (Escape closes it), and the first click outside closes the popover before it reaches what it landed on.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `PeoplePicker.test.tsx` (the component's shared harness file), with the picker inline inside a Radix `Dialog`:

- open popover: the dialog sits under an `aria-hidden` ancestor and the popover does not (the observable half of `modal`);
- the list area carries `flex flex-col min-h-0 flex-1` (jsdom does no layout, so this holds the structure; the geometry is the browser readings below);
- CONTROL, popover closed: the dialog is not hidden, so the hidden reading comes from the open popover and not from the dialog.

Ablations, one for each new pin, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor hit, the blob moved, and it was restored to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty), on `-t "inside a dialog"`:

- dropping `modal`: the `modal` pin fails, the other two pass (1 failed, 2 passed);
- dropping `flex ... flex-col`: the list-area pin fails, the other two pass (1 failed, 2 passed).

<details><summary>Local runs (head ac7171c32)</summary>

- PeoplePicker's five test files: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 47 passed (47).
- `@object-ui/fields` suite (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/`): Test Files 328 passed, 1 skipped (329), Tests 4998 passed, 7 skipped (5005).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check`: exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json` lists `PeoplePicker.test.tsx` (`--listFiles`, 1 hit).
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 37 of 38 run locally, all exit 0. Not measured: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, killed by SIGKILL on the shared box after 5 minutes. It reads none of this diff's files; CI runs it.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The centred desktop dialog's list was also clipped and could not be scrolled, a reachable defect on main that the card did not name. It is fixed by the same one-line class change, because the three containers share the list area. No separate card.

## Verification

Read first: the `ScrollArea` class in `PeoplePicker.tsx` (what makes the list scroll at all), then the `modal` Popover (the behaviour change).

Two minutes: open any create dialog that has a user field, with more users than fit, open the field's dropdown, and scroll it with the wheel: the list moves and the last users can be picked.

<details><summary>Browser readings (harness: Radix Dialog + inline PeoplePicker from source, Tailwind from the components sheet, 1280x800, touch on)</summary>

| case | in dialog | viewport px | max scroll | wheel 5x120 | touch drag | wheel / touch prevented |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| main | yes | 1248 | 0 | 0 to 0 | 0 to 0 | 5/5 · 9/9 |
| main | no | 1248 | 0 | 0 to 0 | 0 to 0 | 0/5 · 0/9 |
| main + list flex column only | yes | 370 | 878 | 0 to 0 | 0 to 0 | 5/5 · 9/9 |
| main + list flex column only | no | 370 | 878 | 0 to 600 | 0 to 129 | 0/5 · 0/8 |
| `modal` only | yes | 1248 | 0 | 0 to 0 | 0 to 0 | 5/5 · 9/9 |
| this PR | yes | 370 | 878 | 0 to 600 | 0 to 129 | 0/5 · 0/8 |
| this PR | no | 370 | 878 | 0 to 600 | 0 to 130 | 0/5 · 0/8 |
| sheet, 375 wide, main | yes | 539 | 709 | 0 to 600 | 0 to 129 | 0/5 · 0/9 |
| sheet, 375 wide, this PR (CONTROL) | yes | 539 | 709 | 0 to 600 | 0 to 127 | 0/5 · 0/6 |
| desktop dialog picker, main | yes | 1248 | 0 | 0 to 0 | 0 to 0 | n/a |
| desktop dialog picker, this PR | yes | 516 | 732 | 0 to 600 | 0 to 127 | 0/5 · 0/8 |

The wheel is capped at 600 by the five 120px ticks, not by the list. The prevented counts are read by a window listener after the document-level lock listener has run.

</details>
